verdict.rationale: Convex documents a public HTTP API and generated TypeScript types. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found that all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404. The generated types and llms.txt are adjacent features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
